reference_sql:
WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event with both IDs, 1 to 7 December 2025 (Dublin days)
  SELECT event_date AS day, user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
), per_id AS (
  -- one row per day and ga_session_id: how many visitors started a session with it
  SELECT day, ga_session_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) AS visitors
  FROM starts
  WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY day, ga_session_id
)
SELECT day, SUM(visitors) AS sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visitors > 1) AS shared_ids
FROM per_id
GROUP BY day

WITH pairs AS (
  -- one row per session: each distinct day, user_pseudo_id and ga_session_id of a session_start event, 1 to 7 December 2025
  SELECT DISTINCT event_date AS day, user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
), per_id AS (
  -- one row per day and ga_session_id: the sessions that share it
  SELECT day, ga_session_id, COUNT(*) AS visitors
  FROM pairs
  WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY day, ga_session_id
)
SELECT day, SUM(visitors) AS sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE visitors > 1) AS shared_ids
FROM per_id
GROUP BY day

WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event with both IDs, 1 to 7 December 2025 (Dublin days)
  SELECT event_date AS day, user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
), day_sessions AS (
  -- one row per day: its distinct sessions
  SELECT day, COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id || '-' || ga_session_id) AS sessions
  FROM starts
  WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY day
), shared AS (
  -- one row per day and ga_session_id that two or more visitors hold
  SELECT day, ga_session_id
  FROM starts
  WHERE ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY day, ga_session_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) > 1
)
SELECT d.day, d.sessions, COUNT(s.ga_session_id) AS shared_ids
FROM day_sessions d
LEFT JOIN shared s ON s.day = d.day
GROUP BY d.day, d.sessions
